question: Should the featured-project section remain a concise text list, or should it adopt live PinMe repository cards despite the additional visual and service dependency?
rationale: VISION.md reserves profile presentation for Peter’s editorial judgment and sets a qualitative reliability and privacy bar that cannot be resolved from the issue examples alone.

options.title: Keep the text list
options.body: Retain the current compact, descriptive project links and decline the additional live-image dependency.

options.title: Pilot selected cards
options.body: Approve a small card-based trial only after PinMe’s reliability, privacy, accessibility, proxy rendering, and maintenance story are documented.

recommendation.title: Keep the text list
recommendation.body: Retain the current compact, descriptive project links and decline the additional live-image dependency.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the profile content and has performed the recurring README curation reflected in repository history.
